allowed_claims: Relaytic-AML can convert a rowless external detector-score artifact into evidence cells with schema, hash, leakage-posture, and claim-state metadata.
Relaytic-AML can produce a rowless handoff summary for hosted detector-output governance.

blocked_claims.claim: The imported detector is superior to current AML detectors.
blocked_claims.gate_reason: P19-A validates governance of an external score artifact, not detector performance.
blocked_claims.missing_evidence: independent benchmark comparison under a validated detector budget

blocked_claims.claim: Relaytic-AML is production-ready for bank AML monitoring.
blocked_claims.gate_reason: No production deployment, analyst study, or bank validation exists.
blocked_claims.missing_evidence: production controls, live data validation, and human analyst outcome study

blocked_claims.gate_reason: The route hosts external detector outputs and does not implement a new graph-neural model.
blocked_claims.missing_evidence: new detector architecture plus benchmark and ablation evidence

blocked_claims.gate_reason: No faithful RevClassifyDS parity run is executed in P19-A.
blocked_claims.missing_evidence: faithful reference replay or accepted parity protocol

blocked_claims.gate_reason: The artifact is rowless governance evidence, not real-bank detector validation.
blocked_claims.missing_evidence: licensed real-bank data, approved evaluation protocol, and independent validation

paper_safe_sentence: Relaytic-AML can wrap a rowless external detector-score artifact in schema, hash, redaction, evidence-cell, and claim-state controls.
